text: Acceptance court complete. Native Ravel and image4s image types, direct GridDomain and PartialSurjection atlas realization, streaming NIfTI, and all downstream consumers are verified. scalafimTestAll passed across JVM and Scala.js; scalafimCompileAll is warning-clean; examplesCompile and examplesTest pass; atlas passes 89 JVM and 61 Scala.js tests; the final NIfTI parity and allocation court passes 14 tests. A pinned nibabel 5.2.1 asymmetric 2x3x4x3 NIfTI and neuroim2 0.19.0 independent oracle agree at all 72 coordinates and world points, regenerate byte-exactly, and prove both ingress and writer order translation. Legacy compatibility types, fromLinear, and public ambiguous linear ordinal APIs are absent; git diff check and receipt JSON validation pass. Publication SHA will be recorded on the parent epic after non-force reconciliation with main.
